original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-linear-functor-over-field}
Let $K$ be a field. Let $L: \text{Mod}^{fg}_K \to
\text{Mod}_K$ be a $K$-linear functor.  Then $L$ is isomorphic to the
functor $L(K) \otimes_K - : \text{Mod}^{fg}_K \to
\text{Mod}_K$.

semantic_review_note: The original specifies a K-linear functor from finite-dimensional vector spaces to all K-vector spaces; its value L(K) determines the functor by natural isomorphisms L(K)⊗_K V→L(V). The reconstruction preserves the domain/codomain and adds no unwarranted exactness assumption.
